notes.title: Okinawa Rush has been released! -15% launch discount
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35591034/95ee26c09dc10852dd14704bc80c831173ba7e78.png[/img]

[h1]Hiya, fighters![/h1]

And the biggest hiya yet! After all this time it finally happened - [b]Okinawa Rush is out![/b] A big Thank you to everyone for supporting the game on this journey, for pledging to the Kickstarter, for wishlisting on various storefronts, for playing the demo, telling your friends about it, sending us feedback or just the kind words! [b]We really couldn’t have done it without you. [/b]

[h2]LAUNCH TRAILER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=hfJtq6LGFMI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Launch Discount[/h2]

You may remember a little thing called the Highscore Quest from last week, where we collected wishlists and certain thresholds unlocked higher launch discounts. Well, thanks to your concerted efforts, we have managed to reach our [b]First Goal (that ensure a -10% release discount)[/b] and collect over 250 wishlists in one week, but… because we really love you and we’d like to thank you for your continuing support, [b]we set a release discount at -15% anyway![/b]

Now, without further ado, we are proud to present Okinawa Rush! Hope you’ll have as much fun playing it as we’ve had when making it!

[b]Anyway, have fun, and stay fighting![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/777670/Okinawa_Rush/
